--- header_pre ---
#define j0 _j0
#define j1 _j1
#define jn _jn
#define y0 _y0
#define y1 _y1
#define yn _yn
#define gamma _gamma
#define lgamma _lgamma
#define tgamma _tgamma
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#undef j0
#undef j1
#undef jn
#undef y0
#undef y1
#undef yn
#undef gamma
#undef lgamma
#undef tgamma

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
  // Eye-space light positions, set before the camera transform.
  glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0, GL_POSITION, repl_glfloat4(0, 0, -1, 1));
--- camera ---
  // camera
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -9.5000f);
  glRotatef(14.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(12.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.5000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  static float d; // sliding cut offset for the animated cutaway
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);

  // Clip planes carve new shapes out of stock solids. glClipPlane sets a
  // plane equation a*x + b*y + c*z + d >= 0; GL keeps that half-space and
  // discards everything else. The equation is captured in the modelview
  // frame current AT THE CALL, so transforms placed before glClipPlane
  // position the plane. glEnable(GL_CLIP_PLANEi) switches each one on.
  // Tip: park the cursor on a glClipPlane line to see its plane guide.

  glClearColor(0.04, 0.05, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);
  // Clipping opens each solid up, so light the exposed inside faces too:
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, 1);

  // 1) Dome - one plane. (0, 1, 0, 0) keeps y >= 0: the sphere's top
  // half. The plane rides the translated frame, so it cuts through the
  // sphere's own equator, not the world origin.
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-2.9, 0.75, 0);
    glClipPlane(GL_CLIP_PLANE0, (GLdouble[]){0, 1, 0, 0});
    glEnable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
    glColor3f(0.95, 0.55, 0.3);
    glutSolidSphere(1.15, 28, 20);
    glDisable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
  glPopMatrix();

  // 2) Wedge - two planes. Each plane keeps half the sphere; rotating
  // the frame 120 degrees between the two calls overlaps the kept halves
  // into a 120-degree orange slice. The slow spin carries the flat cut
  // faces around so you can see both of them.
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(0, 0.75, 0);
    glRotatef(20*t, 0, 1, 0);
    glClipPlane(GL_CLIP_PLANE0, (GLdouble[]){0, 0, 1, 0});
    glEnable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
    glRotatef(120, 0, 1, 0);
    glClipPlane(GL_CLIP_PLANE1, (GLdouble[]){0, 0, -1, 0});
    glEnable(GL_CLIP_PLANE1);
    glRotatef(-120, 0, 1, 0); // back to the wedge's frame before drawing
    glColor3f(0.4, 0.82, 0.5);
    glutSolidSphere(1.15, 28, 20);
    glDisable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
    glDisable(GL_CLIP_PLANE1);
  glPopMatrix();

  // 3) Cutaway - coefficients can animate. {-1, 0, 0, d} keeps x <= d,
  // so sweeping d slides the plane through the torus and exposes the
  // tube's circular cross-sections.
  d = 1.5*sin(0.7*t);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(2.9, 0.75, 0);
    glClipPlane(GL_CLIP_PLANE0, (GLdouble[]){-1, 0, 0, d});
    glEnable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
    glColor3f(0.42, 0.62, 0.95);
    glutSolidTorus(0.42, 0.85, 20, 28);
    glDisable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
  glPopMatrix();

  // Captions (lighting off so the text color is not shaded)
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.78, 0.82, 0.9);
  glRasterPos3f(-3.6, -0.85, 0);
  label("1 plane: dome");
  glRasterPos3f(-0.85, -0.85, 0);
  label("2 planes: wedge");
  glRasterPos3f(2, -0.85, 0);
  label("animated d: cutaway");
